parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation blade of a folding knife made of stainless steel, designed for cutting tasks.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one of the cutting edges that can rotate out from the handle for use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to open or close relative to the base body.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation blade of the folding knife, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional cutting or sawing function depending on its edge design.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the same pivot mechanism to deploy or retract into the handle.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This rotation blade is part of the knife’s multi-tool system, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It can be used for specialized cutting or scraping tasks.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the hinge to fold in or out of the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the folding knife, made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the rotation blades and provides a grip for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blades rotate around the pivot joint attached to it.
